diploma.name: IT Architecture Expert
diploma.objective: The IT Architecture Expert's mission is to define and design robust architectures that align information systems with the strategic goals of companies. Their role includes assessing user needs, designing technical solutions, and monitoring technology to keep up with changes in the field.

competencies.title: Certified Skills
competencies.subtitle: The skills validated by the certification.

bc01.title: Define and design the IT architecture of a digital solution
bc01.description: Analyze needs, design the hardware and software architecture, and assess security risks for an IT project.

items.techWatch: Carry out continuous technology watch across various digital fields to stay up to date and offer clients innovative and responsible solutions
items.innovation: Look for innovative solutions by testing new techniques and software and integrating them into existing solutions, in order to optimize processes and strengthen the organization's technological capabilities
items.infrastructureAudit: Analyze the current IT infrastructure to identify its strengths and weaknesses, using audit and performance analysis tools, in order to understand the system's starting point
items.stakeholderNeeds: Identify the project stakeholders and gather their needs and expectations through interviews and workshops, in order to define the project's goals and constraints while taking everyone's specifics and interests into account
items.feasibility: Assess the project's feasibility by estimating the resources required to carry it out, using simulation and prototyping tools, in order to validate the viability of the proposed solutions
items.specifications: Formalize the sponsor's needs in a technical specification covering both the current infrastructure and a functional projection of the target infrastructure, in order to provide a clear and structured basis for designing, implementing and accepting solutions aligned with the project's strategic goals
items.architectureDesign: Design the hardware and software architecture by choosing among possible strategies and using architecture modeling tools, following eco-responsible practices, to visualize the system's components and their interactions
items.technologySelection: Select the hardware, tools and technologies suited to the defined architecture based on project needs, budget constraints and current trends, in order to ensure a high-performing and scalable solution
items.securityRisks: Assess security risks through standard risk analyses, modeling of known threats and specific risk scenarios, in order to build security measures in from the project's design and protect data and systems against threats

bc02.title: Build the architecture of information systems and networks
bc02.description: Install, secure and administer the servers, networks and services that make up the information system.

items.servers: Install and administer physical and virtual servers, on-premises and remote (Cloud), using operating systems such as Linux and Windows Server and virtualization and containerization methods such as ESXi and Docker, to ensure the availability, performance and eco-responsibility of hosted services
items.ipNetwork: Set up an IP network architecture by installing, connecting and configuring network equipment (routers, switches, firewalls, gateways, …), following communication protocols and integrating architecture, performance, eco-responsibility and transit constraints, so that machines can communicate with each other and meet the need
items.networkServices: Install and configure the network services that together make up the information system, such as centralized user management, messaging, shared and distributed storage and computing, business tools and DevOps tools, to ensure a stable, secure and high-performing infrastructure that lets users and applications run optimally and continuously in an evolving environment
items.administration: Administer the network and services using scheduled tasks, suitable monitoring software, or ad-hoc software or scripts tailored to the information system's specifics, to ensure the daily service delivered to all its users
items.testing: Carry out and supervise, with dedicated teams, functional and load tests on the architecture to verify that it meets client needs, the technical specification and activity peaks, and apply the appropriate fixes when needed
items.securityObjectives: Set clear and specific security objectives in collaboration with stakeholders, to ensure that security measures address the organization's challenges
items.securityPolicies: Implement network and system security policies by selecting, installing and configuring firewalls, VPNs and intrusion detection systems (IDS/IPS), to protect data and infrastructures against threats and increase resilience (redundancy, backup)
items.identityAccess: Manage access and identities by configuring user databases or directories (such as Active Directory, LDAP) and authentication and authorization policies, to ensure secure and compliant access to network and system resources
items.securityTesting: Organize and carry out security tests (penetration tests, security audits, vulnerability scans) using methods such as attack simulations (virus, rootkit, man-in-the-middle), code analyses and configuration reviews, and tools such as Nessus, OpenVAS and Qualys, to identify and fix security flaws in networks and systems, as well as social engineering tests aimed at tricking users into granting undue access

bc04.title: Lead the implementation of the IT architecture
bc04.description: Select resources, organize the project and lead teams through to delivery of the architecture.

items.selectionCriteria: Set the selection criteria for external resources in terms of data security, environmental responsibility, expertise, range of services and solutions, quality of support and accessibility, in order to be as competitive as possible in delivering the project and the expressed needs
items.externalResources: Select the external resources (hardware, human, services) needed to build the chosen system and network or database and data architecture, within budget, at the expected quality and in compliance with standards (environmental, security, legislation)
items.projectPlan: Build the project organization plan by identifying its phases and the actions to carry out, within cost-time-quality constraints, communicating objectives to the teams and identifying technical risks, to ensure the IT project runs smoothly
items.teamLeadership: Lead the project and all its contributors, preventing conflicts and adapting to the various profiles involved, including people with disabilities, to maintain strong overall cohesion
items.projectSteering: Steer and supervise the IT project's implementation, ensuring objectives are defined and met, anticipating and managing risks, and adjusting the project when needed, to guarantee its success in line with client needs and the specification
items.delivery: Deliver the finished project to production, checking deliverables internally and then with the client, and reviewing changes and their impacts, to ensure client satisfaction, compliance with initial requirements and a smooth transition to operations

bc05.title: Manage the deployment and continuous optimization of the IT architecture
bc05.description: Document, maintain and evolve the architecture to meet new needs.

items.documentation: Write and review user documentation for clients, users and production managers, to ensure the accuracy and consistency of the information provided
items.documentationSharing: Share the documentation with all stakeholders across the organization through explanatory or training sessions, to ensure a shared and consistent understanding of key information
items.maintenance: Carry out evolutive maintenance of applications by fixing issues reported automatically from production or raised (bugs) by users or dedicated teams, to ensure the performance, stability and continuous evolution of applications
items.newNeeds: Gather new infrastructure needs from clients and users in order to optimize the existing architecture
items.architectureEvolution: Implement architecture changes to meet the new needs of the various stakeholders (client, user, supervisor, developer, …), taking into account technical constraints, performance and security requirements, as well as allocated deadlines and budgets, to ensure a consistent and effective adaptation of systems
